chapters.text: Upload numbers, split them into batches for agents, and watch the team live.

Choose the campaign type: CSR (the calling team; interested callers go to the sales team by rotation) or Sales (sales agents call; an interested caller becomes their own lead). A sales agent's interested caller always becomes their own lead, whatever the type. Make batches only lists agents of that type.
Fill “Numbers came from” (e.g. Emaar buyers list, provided by Ahmed): agents see it on every call, with who gave them the numbers.

Calls → Campaigns → New campaign: name, script, WhatsApp message and, if your phone system needs it, a dial prefix (e.g. 27 for a 3CX route: +971… is dialled as 27971…; the saved number doesn't change).

Add numbers: choose an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file, then say what each column is — Phone number, Second phone, Full name, or First name + Last name (joined), Show to agent (project, unit, nationality, email…, rename them if you like), Keep, hide from agents, or Don't import (hide as many columns as you like). Change it any time in What agents see on the campaign: tick what agents see, untick to hide, Save. Every column of the sheet is listed. Duplicates and do-not-call numbers are skipped.

Call order on the campaign: Top first (file order), Bottom first, Random, or By a column (e.g. Unit or Project, A→Z / Z→A). It decides which numbers go into batches first and which number each agent gets next.

Make batches: set the numbers per batch, pick the All / CSR agents / Sales agents tab (or search), tick people and set how many batches each gets, then Give batches (or Split all equally). Everyone with dialer access shows, from a role or a personal access exception; a red “Can't save calls” means they still need Calls → Edit.
Agents mark their share Completed from their dialer when they've called all their numbers; their batch then shows “Completed by agent”, and a campaign with nothing left becomes done.

2nd round (CSR campaigns): when a CSR agent completes, their Not answered, Busy, Voicemail, Switched off and Wrong numbers start a 2nd round inside the same campaign, as a new batch for the same agent, and you get a notification with the count. On the campaign the numbers are tagged 2nd round (filter: 2nd round). After the 2nd round there's no further round.

Agents can work several campaigns at once: give batches from as many campaigns as you like. They choose one or all of them at the top of their dialer, where they also see the campaign's description, source and “Numbers came from”, so keep those filled in.
Wallboard shows each agent live (ready, ringing, on a call) and today's numbers; Reports shows totals by agent and outcome.

Calls → Targets: give each agent a daily target (an exact number or a range) for calls made, connected and interested. Agents see it on their dialer; Targets shows today's progress and the last 7 days.

Tick campaigns in the list to Activate, Pause, Mark done or Delete them; inside a campaign tick numbers to give them to an agent, send them back to unassigned, call again, put them on do-not-call or delete them. Delete on a campaign removes it with its numbers (calls made stay in History and Reports).
Reports → Daily reports: each agent's report and the team totals in the WhatsApp format, with Copy all and Send on WhatsApp.
Super Admins can download every imported file and pasted list exactly as it came in, under Imported files on the campaign.
Do-not-call keeps numbers that must never be called again.
Only supervisors and Super Admins manage campaigns, batches, the wallboard and everyone's reports; CSR agents only work their own queue. Recordings are for Super Admins only.
